description: Print what a code-mode script can use: the TypeScript typings of its tools, the hash of the tool list they were made from and the limits of a run. It works whether or not code mode is switched on.

dts.description: The TypeScript declarations a script is written against

schemaSha256.description: The hash of the tool list the declarations were made from

limits.description: maxSourceBytes, defaultTimeoutMs, minTimeoutMs, maxTimeoutMs, runCapSeconds, maxCalls, maxInFlight, maxResultBytes, maxLogBytes, maxConcurrentRuns
